notes: 6 Hitpoints, max hit 1 (crush), 4-tick attack speed, Defence level 2 with no bonuses (npc 1038/2848).

locationComparison.name: Monkey spawns
notes: Karamja holds numerous monkey clusters and is the most convenient place to complete the task.

Nearly every monkey spawn is cannonable per the wiki; the Karamja overworld clusters shown here are single-combat and not safespottable, while spots such as Marim, Temple of Marimbo and Ape Atoll Dungeon are multicombat and/or safespottable.

taskNotes: Monkeys has no combat or Slayer level requirement and is assigned by Turael or Spria (Mazchna does not assign Monkeys).
slayerTargetId 298 is SYNTHETIC (c2-c3-worklist section 1 allocation contract); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
wikiPageId 18457 is the Monkey (monster) page; only regular monkeys count.
Monkey: combat level 3, 6 HP, max hit 1 (crush), Defence 2 with no bonuses (npc 1038/2848).
Only wiki-confirmed npcIds (1038, 2848) are recorded; other Karamja/Ape Atoll monkey spawn ids are honest-UNKNOWN (not fabricated).
Maniacal monkeys are a separate monster and do NOT count toward this task, nor do the Monkey Madness bosses (Kruk, M'amba).
Monkeys are not undead, so the salve amulet does not apply. No task extension unlock exists for Monkeys.
recommendedMethod: Kill common monkeys (combat level 3) on Karamja with any weapon; with 6 Hitpoints and no defensive bonuses they die in one or two hits. Ape Atoll and Mos Le'Harmless monkeys also count. Avoid Maniacal monkeys, which do not count toward the task.
